chars.MOHAMED: MOHAMED: a slim 19-year-old Moroccan young man with short curly black hair, wearing a bright red hoodie with a white stripe across the chest, black track pants and white sneakers
chars.CHAIMAE: CHAIMAE: a 19-year-old Moroccan young woman with long dark wavy hair in a ponytail, wearing a mustard-yellow denim jacket over a white t-shirt and light blue jeans
chars.MOM: MOM: a stern, strong Moroccan mother in her late forties, wearing a dark green djellaba and a tight black headscarf, thick eyebrows, arms often crossed
chars.DAD: DAD: a tired Moroccan father in his fifties with a grey moustache, wearing a beige work shirt and brown trousers, holding a cigarette

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Evening on the flat rooftop of an old stone house in a popular neighbourhood of Salé, Morocco. MOHAMED and CHAIMAE sit close together on a mat inside a small open rooftop room without a door, both turning their heads in fright toward the rooftop stairway door, as if they heard footsteps. Laundry lines and satellite dishes around, rooftops of Salé behind.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Split view of an old Moroccan house: on a narrow stone staircase DAD climbs up toward the rooftop door with an unlit cigarette in his mouth; just above, on the rooftop, MOHAMED and CHAIMAE freeze in panic, eyes wide, MOHAMED pressing a finger to his lips.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Night, old rooftop in Salé: MOHAMED leans over the low rooftop wall checking the street below like a lookout, waving behind his back; CHAIMAE tiptoes up the outside rooftop stairs behind him holding her sneakers in her hand, both grinning nervously.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Warm sunset on a Moroccan rooftop with laundry hanging on lines: MOHAMED and CHAIMAE laugh carelessly, sitting on plastic crates, sharing a glass of mint tea, completely relaxed, the rooftop stairway door wide open behind them.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Inside a small garage-like rooftop room with no door, open front, old cushions and a small radio: MOHAMED and CHAIMAE sit side by side chatting happily, CHAIMAE showing MOHAMED something funny on her phone, golden evening light, Salé rooftops visible outside.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan rooftop at dusk, wide shot: MOHAMED and CHAIMAE dance clumsily and laugh between the laundry lines, a cheeky romantic moment, the city lights of Salé starting to glow around them.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: A nosy neighbour woman in a pink headscarf peeks from behind a curtain at her window across a narrow derb in Salé, eyes narrowed, spying; in the background on the opposite rooftop MOHAMED and CHAIMAE are small figures sitting together, unaware.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Morning at the blue wooden front door of an old house in a Salé derb: MOM in her djellaba holds her handbag as if leaving for the day, but glances back up toward the rooftop with a suspicious, knowing look; DAD walks off to work in the background; two small children with school backpacks wait by her side.
